text: Which standalone grinder should a Breville/Sage Barista Express or Barista Pro owner buy when the built-in grinder has reached its limit? (Follow-up to the built-in grinder diagnosis guide; link the two.)
note: From Ron after reading the Barista Express/Pro diagnosis draft.

attempts.why: Became standalone-grinder-for-barista-express-pro, which also covers the wanted guide grinder-for-barista-express-and-pro. Searched forum and Reddit phrasings ('Barista Express grinder upgrade', 'which grinder with Barista Express'). Reddit (www and old), Home-Barista (403), Coffee Forums UK (redirects to a paywall that wouldn't resolve), Slickdeals (403), boards.ie and Overclockers UK (403) all blocked. The two signals I read are OzBargain threads (Australia). I found no readable US or UK owner thread.
